title: Vehicle log
description: Vehicles, trips and fuel with a child table, a script that flags fuel above the norm, monthly straight-line depreciation and a monthly cost report.

fields.label: Book value
fields.help: set every month by the scheduled calculation (straight line)

modules.name: Trip
modules.description: A trip with its kilometres and fuel.

scripts.name: Flag fuel above the norm
scripts.description: Compares l/100 km with the vehicle type norm (+10 %).
scripts.code:
# After a trip is saved: compare its fuel use with the norm of the vehicle type and flag it when it is more than 10 % above.
v = records.get("vehicle", record["vehicle"])
if v is None:
    stop("The vehicle of the trip is not found.")
norm = v["norm"] or 0
use = record["consumption"] or 0
over = norm > 0 and use > norm * number("1.10")
record.update({"norm": norm, "flagged": over})
log(f"{record.number}: {use} l/100 km, norm {norm} – {'ABOVE the norm' if over else 'ok'}")
if over and record["driver"]:
    d = employees.get(record["driver"])
    if d is not None and d.user_id:
        notify(d, "Fuel above the norm", f"Trip {record.number} ({v['plate']}): {use} l/100 km, norm {norm}.")

scheduled.name: Monthly depreciation (straight line)
scheduled.formula: IF(BLANK(purchase_date) or life_months <= 0, cost, MAX(cost - cost / life_months * MONTHS(purchase_date, TODAY()), 0))
